owner_approval: Option A, local-24-byte-header, approved without amendment on 2026-07-19.
claim_limit: Format addendum only. It emits no C2 image, changes no product byte, authorizes no capacity and makes no execution claim.
gap: The approved C2I-v1 contract defines entry and literal records but not the self-describing metadata header, section counts, entry flag bits or string-record boundaries required by a device decoder.

options.reason: Keeps each C2I region self-describing without changing the approved 32-byte L65S-v4 shelf record.
Couples container-internal counts to the shelf and pays a second catalog-layout change.
Would let the proof target pass without proving a self-describing product decoder.

sections.rule: Sections are contiguous, offsets and arithmetic are checked before access, and the optional final alignment byte is zero. The L65S-v4 record metadata length must equal metadata_bytes.

string_pool.record: length_u16 followed by exactly length raw bytes; records are packed without terminators or per-record padding
string_pool.offset_base: Every entry or literal string offset is relative to the first byte of the local string pool and points to a record's length_u16.
string_pool.binary_string_rule: Immutable strings may contain any byte including NUL; descriptor argument0 equals the record length.
string_pool.symbol_name_rule: Export-name records contain 1..255 canonical 7-bit ASCII bytes with no NUL or reader whitespace; the device performs no case folding.

entry_flags.rules: Anonymous entries have export_name_offset=0xffff and cannot carry either export flag. A late-bound entry is named and no literal may target it by ordinal. Entry arity and literal count must equal the immutable code-object header.

recommended_contract.literal_flags: zero in C2I-v1; every unused argument and the descriptor reserved byte are zero
recommended_contract.code_normalization: Each entry covers one complete current-ABI code object. The literal-shaped bytes after the seven-byte code header are zero, header NLITS equals entry literal_count, header NARGS equals entry arity, and 7 + 2*NLITS + payload_length equals entry code_length. PUSHLIT reads the session resolution table.

required_negative_fixtures: header, entry or literal size mismatch
nonzero header flags or reserved field
section arithmetic overflow, gap, overlap or nonzero alignment byte
metadata length differs from the L65S record
entry code or literal range outside its region
entry flags outside 0x03 or export flags on an anonymous entry
string offset not at a record boundary or record crossing the pool
symbol name empty, longer than 255 or outside canonical ASCII
unknown literal kind, nonzero literal flags/reserved or nonzero unused argument
string descriptor length differs from its string record
owner_decision: local-24-byte-header approved; C2.1 must emit and decode this exact envelope
